tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every pane. Text on it: fg, dim, and the signal hues.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Terminal panes, side tab rows, dialog bodies.

tokens.name: panel-2
tokens.usage: Pane headers, the status line, hovered rows, input fields.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around inputs. Decorative only, never the sole marker of state.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Pane borders, the notched pixel frame on neutral panels, keycap edges (3:1 on bg).

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, panel and panel-2 (13:1 on bg).

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text, timestamps, metadata, on bg, panel and panel-2 (6:1 on bg).

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Disabled glyphs, empty block-strip cells, gutters. Never body text (3:1 on bg).

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: The hard 6px pixel shadow under frames, chips and buttons.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: The one accent: needs you. A Claude session waiting on a permission or a question, the focus ring, drop targets, the primary action. Text on bg and panel (8:1).

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an amber fill (12:1).

tokens.name: amber-edge
tokens.usage: The notched outline around amber chips and the primary button.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Done: a Claude turn finished, a command exited 0. Text on bg and panel (6:1). Always paired with a check glyph or the word.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Failed: a command exited non-zero, a session crashed. Text on bg and panel (5:1). Always paired with a cross glyph or the word.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Running: a command or a Claude turn in progress. Links and artifact URLs. Text on bg and panel (6:1).

tokens.name: magenta
tokens.usage: Pins, variables and pinned excerpts. Text on bg and panel (6:1).

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Agent output in the transcript, tool calls. Text on bg and panel (9:1).

tokens.name: tint-blue
tokens.usage: Side tab and tab background a person picks to sort work. Blue mixed 16% into panel. fg holds 11:1 on it.

tokens.name: tint-cyan
tokens.usage: Picked background, cyan 16% into panel.

tokens.name: tint-green
tokens.usage: Picked background, green 16% into panel.

tokens.name: tint-magenta
tokens.usage: Picked background, magenta 16% into panel.

tokens.name: tint-red
tokens.usage: Picked background, red 16% into panel.

tokens.name: tint-amber
tokens.usage: Drop targets while dragging a tab, and the background of a side tab that needs you. Not offered as a picked background.

tokens.name: neon-cyan
tokens.usage: Neon row accents (task 8.25): a new side tab's edge and icon, picked so rows differ. No amber, orange or yellow.

tokens.name: neon-pink
tokens.usage: Neon row accent.

tokens.name: neon-lime
tokens.usage: Neon row accent.

tokens.name: neon-violet
tokens.usage: Neon row accent.

tokens.name: neon-mint
tokens.usage: Neon row accent.

tokens.name: neon-blue
tokens.usage: Neon row accent.

tokens.name: neon-rose
tokens.usage: Neon row accent.

tokens.name: neon-ice
tokens.usage: Neon row accent.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Text selected in a terminal or transcript pane, before Pin or Extract.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px. An alias of amber.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and artifact URLs. An alias of blue.

tokens.name: ansi-0
tokens.usage: Terminal black. Lighter than bg so programs that paint black stay visible.

tokens.name: ansi-1
tokens.usage: Terminal red.

tokens.name: ansi-2
tokens.usage: Terminal green.

tokens.name: ansi-3
tokens.usage: Terminal yellow. Its own hue: amber stays the needs-you signal (D16).

tokens.name: ansi-4
tokens.usage: Terminal blue.

tokens.name: ansi-5
tokens.usage: Terminal magenta.

tokens.name: ansi-6
tokens.usage: Terminal cyan.

tokens.name: ansi-7
tokens.usage: Terminal white, a step below fg.

tokens.name: ansi-8
tokens.usage: Terminal bright black: shell autosuggestions and comments (4:1 on bg).

tokens.name: ansi-9
tokens.usage: Terminal bright red.

tokens.name: ansi-10
tokens.usage: Terminal bright green.

tokens.name: ansi-11
tokens.usage: Terminal bright yellow.

tokens.name: ansi-12
tokens.usage: Terminal bright blue.

tokens.name: ansi-13
tokens.usage: Terminal bright magenta.

tokens.name: ansi-14
tokens.usage: Terminal bright cyan.

tokens.name: ansi-15
tokens.usage: Terminal bright white.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: Geist Mono carries every readable word: terminal, transcript, forms, tables.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Dialog subjects and the prompt library preview title.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default for everything: transcript, forms, template bodies.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Side tab names, the active tab, numbers that need weight.

styles.name: term
styles.usage: xterm.js panes. Tighter leading than body so TUIs fit.

groups.name: Pixel
groups.note: Silkscreen is trim. Labels of eight characters or fewer, always uppercase, never sentences.

styles.name: pixel-display
styles.usage: The cover and the app's boot screen only.

tokens.name: px
tokens.usage: One pixel of trim: frame edges, notches, block-strip gaps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph-to-label gap, chip padding top and bottom.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips, keycaps, buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Pane padding, row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Dialog padding, gaps between tiled panes.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections of a dialog or the library grid.

radius.note: Square. The notch replaces the rounded corner.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Frames, panes, buttons, chips, everything with a notched frame.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Text inputs and the xterm cursor.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Tooltips only.

shadow.note: Hard offset shadows only. No blur anywhere.

tokens.name: shadow-hard
tokens.usage: Floating frames: dialogs, toasts, the command palette.

tokens.name: shadow-hard-sm
tokens.usage: Chips and buttons at rest.

tokens.name: frame-neutral
tokens.usage: The notched pixel frame: four 2px edges leave the corners open. Dialogs and pin cards.

tokens.name: frame-amber
tokens.usage: Notched frame on amber fills: the primary button, the waiting chip.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px ground gap, then 2px solid amber.

duration.note: Arcade cues: stepped, short. Off under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: step-fast
tokens.usage: Block-strip cell fill, chip press.

tokens.name: step-slow
tokens.usage: Toast slide-in, done-flash on a step.
